- Kashmir Paradise (6D/5N): ₹25,000 - ₹40,000/person
- Darjeeling-Sikkim Tour (7D/6N): ₹18,000 - ₹28,000/person

🏰 HERITAGE & CULTURE:

Ask me about any destination for more details!

🏖️ GOA BEACH ESCAPE
- Duration: 5 Days / 4 Nights
- Estimated Cost: ₹12,000 - ₹18,000 per person
- Best Time to Visit: October to March
- Type: Beach, Nightlife, Water Sports
- Highlights: Baga & Calangute Beach, Old Goa Churches (UNESCO), Water Sports at Dona Paula, Dudhsagar Waterfalls, Anjuna Flea Market
- Includes: Hotel stay, Breakfast, Sightseeing transfers
- Travel Style: Adventure, Family, Budget & Luxury options available

🏝️ ANDAMAN ISLAND PARADISE
- Duration: 7 Days / 6 Nights
- Estimated Cost: ₹28,000 - ₹45,000 per person
- Best Time to Visit: October to May
- Type: Beach, Water Sports, Nature
- Highlights: Radhanagar Beach (Asia's Best Beach), Scuba Diving & Snorkeling, Cellular Jail (Port Blair), Havelock & Neil Island, Glass Bottom Boat Ride
- Includes: Hotel stay, Breakfast, Ferry transfers, Sightseeing
- Travel Style: Honeymoon, Adventure, Family

🌴 KERALA - GOD'S OWN COUNTRY
- Duration: 7 Days / 6 Nights
- Estimated Cost: ₹20,000 - ₹32,000 per person
- Best Time to Visit: September to March
- Type: Nature, Beach, Culture, Wellness
- Highlights: Alleppey Houseboat Stay, Munnar Tea Gardens, Kovalam & Varkala Beaches, Thekkady Wildlife Sanctuary, Kathakali Dance Performance, Ayurvedic Spa
- Includes: Hotel + Houseboat stay, Breakfast, Sightseeing
- Travel Style: Honeymoon, Family, Luxury, Culture

🏰 RAJASTHAN ROYAL HERITAGE TOUR
- Duration: 10 Days / 9 Nights
- Estimated Cost: ₹20,000 - ₹38,000 per person
- Best Time to Visit: October to February
- Type: Heritage, Culture, Desert Safari
- Highlights: Amber Fort (Jaipur), City Palace (Udaipur), Mehrangarh Fort (Jodhpur), Jaisalmer Desert Safari, Pushkar Lake, Hawa Mahal, Camel Ride
- Includes: Hotel stay, Breakfast, Sightseeing transfers
- Travel Style: Cultural, Family, Luxury, Heritage

🏔️ MANALI-SPITI ADVENTURE
- Duration: 8 Days / 7 Nights
- Estimated Cost: ₹22,000 - ₹35,000 per person
- Best Time to Visit: April to October (Spiti: June-September)
- Type: Adventure, Trekking, Snow, Nature
- Highlights: Rohtang Pass, Spiti Valley Monasteries, Solang Valley (Snow Activities), Kullu River Rafting, Hidimba Temple Manali, Kaza & Key Monastery
- Includes: Hotel/Camp stay, Meals, Sightseeing & Transfers
- Travel Style: Adventure, Backpacking, Youth Travel

🌸 KASHMIR PARADISE
- Duration: 6 Days / 5 Nights
- Estimated Cost: ₹25,000 - ₹40,000 per person
- Best Time to Visit: March to June (Tulip season), Dec-Jan (Snow)
- Type: Nature, Romance, Adventure
- Highlights: Dal Lake Shikara Ride, Gulmarg Gondola (Asia's highest), Pahalgam Valley, Betaab Valley, Mughal Gardens, Houseboat Stay, Skiing in Gulmarg
- Includes: Houseboat + Hotel stay, Breakfast, Sightseeing
- Travel Style: Honeymoon, Family, Adventure, Luxury

🍵 DARJEELING-SIKKIM HIMALAYAN TOUR
- Duration: 7 Days / 6 Nights
- Estimated Cost: ₹18,000 - ₹28,000 per person
- Best Time to Visit: March to May, September to December
- Type: Nature, Culture, Adventure, Tea Tourism
- Highlights: Tiger Hill Sunrise (Kanchenjunga view), Darjeeling Tea Garden, Batasia Loop, Gangtok Rumtek Monastery, Tsomgo Lake, Nathula Pass (Indo-China border), Toy Train Ride
- Includes: Hotel stay, Breakfast, Sightseeing
- Travel Style: Family, Honeymoon, Cultural, Nature

🛕 VARANASI & AGRA SPIRITUAL-HERITAGE TOUR
- Duration: 5 Days / 4 Nights
- Estimated Cost: ₹12,000 - ₹20,000 per person
- Best Time to Visit: October to March
- Type: Spiritual, Heritage, Cultural
- Highlights: Varanasi Ganga Aarti (Dashashwamedh Ghat), Sarnath Buddhist Site, Taj Mahal at Sunrise (Agra), Agra Fort, Boat Ride on the Ganges, Kashi Vishwanath Temple
- Includes: Hotel stay, Breakfast, Sightseeing
- Travel Style: Spiritual, Cultural, Heritage, Family

🌿 MEGHALAYA & ASSAM NORTHEAST EXPLORER
- Duration: 8 Days / 7 Nights
- Estimated Cost: ₹22,000 - ₹36,000 per person
- Best Time to Visit: October to April
- Type: Nature, Wildlife, Culture, Adventure
- Highlights: Cherrapunji (Wettest place on Earth), Living Root Bridges, Dawki River (Crystal Clear), Kaziranga National Park (One-Horned Rhino Safari), Shillong Peak, Umiam Lake, Mawlynnong (Asia's Cleanest Village)
- Includes: Hotel stay, Breakfast, Sightseeing & Transfers
- Travel Style: Adventure, Nature, Wildlife, Cultural

⛰️ LEH-LADAKH HIGH ALTITUDE ADVENTURE
- Duration: 7 Days / 6 Nights
- Estimated Cost: ₹25,000 - ₹42,000 per person
- Best Time to Visit: June to September
- Type: Adventure, Trekking, Bikes, Nature
- Highlights: Pangong Lake (Iconic 3 Idiots location), Nubra Valley Camel Safari, Khardung La Pass (World's highest motorable road), Magnetic Hill, Hemis Monastery, Tso Moriri Lake, Leh Palace
- Includes: Hotel/Camp stay, Breakfast, Sightseeing
- Travel Style: Adventure, Backpacking, Biking, Youth

🌺 KARNATAKA EXPLORER
- Duration: 6 Days / 5 Nights
- Estimated Cost: ₹14,000 - ₹24,000 per person
- Best Time to Visit: October to March
- Type: Heritage, Nature, Coffee Estates
- Highlights: Hampi UNESCO Ruins, Coorg Coffee Plantations & Abbey Falls, Mysore Palace (Illuminated on Sundays), Jog Falls, Kabini Wildlife Sanctuary, Badami Cave Temples
- Includes: Hotel stay, Breakfast, Sightseeing
- Travel Style: Cultural, Nature, Family, Budget

🏛️ TAMIL NADU CULTURAL & NATURE TOUR
- Duration: 7 Days / 6 Nights
- Estimated Cost: ₹15,000 - ₹26,000 per person
- Best Time to Visit: November to February
- Type: Heritage, Hill Station, Spiritual
- Highlights: Meenakshi Amman Temple (Madurai), Ooty Nilgiri Mountain Railway, Kodaikanal Lake, Rameswaram Temple, Marina Beach (Chennai), Thanjavur Brihadeeswarar Temple (UNESCO)
- Includes: Hotel stay, Breakfast, Sightseeing
- Travel Style: Cultural, Spiritual, Family, Heritage

🏙️ MAHARASHTRA TOUR
- Duration: 6 Days / 5 Nights
- Estimated Cost: ₹14,000 - ₹22,000 per person
- Best Time to Visit: October to March
- Type: Heritage, City, Nature
- Highlights: Ajanta & Ellora Caves (UNESCO World Heritage), Gateway of India (Mumbai), Lonavala & Khandala Hill Stations, Shirdi Sai Baba Temple, Mahabaleshwar Hill Station, Elephanta Caves
- Includes: Hotel stay, Breakfast, Sightseeing
- Travel Style: Cultural, Heritage, Family, Spiritual

🦁 GUJARAT HERITAGE & WILDLIFE TOUR
- Duration: 7 Days / 6 Nights
- Estimated Cost: ₹16,000 - ₹28,000 per person
- Best Time to Visit: October to March (Rann Utsav: Nov-Feb)
- Type: Wildlife, Heritage, Salt Flats
- Highlights: Gir National Park (Asiatic Lion Safari), Rann of Kutch White Desert, Dwarka & Somnath Temples, Adalaj Stepwell, Sabarmati Ashram (Ahmedabad), Statue of Unity (Kevadia)
- Includes: Hotel stay, Breakfast, Sightseeing
- Travel Style: Wildlife, Spiritual, Cultural, Family

🌊 LAKSHADWEEP CORAL ISLAND RETREAT
- Duration: 5 Days / 4 Nights
- Estimated Cost: ₹30,000 - ₹55,000 per person
- Best Time to Visit: October to May
- Type: Beach, Snorkeling, Water Sports
- Highlights: Agatti Island (Pristine Lagoons), Bangaram Island Resort, Snorkeling & Scuba Diving in Coral Reefs, Kayaking, Glass Bottom Boat Ride, Deep Sea Fishing
- Includes: Resort stay, All Meals, Water sports
- Travel Style: Luxury, Honeymoon, Beach, Adventure
- Note: Entry requires permit (arranged by Travaya)

🛕 ODISHA SPIRITUAL & BEACH TOUR
- Duration: 5 Days / 4 Nights
- Estimated Cost: ₹11,000 - ₹18,000 per person
- Best Time to Visit: October to March
- Type: Spiritual, Heritage, Beach
- Highlights: Jagannath Temple Puri, Konark Sun Temple (UNESCO), Puri Golden Beach, Chilika Lake (Asia's largest brackish lake), Nandankanan Zoo, Lingaraj Temple Bhubaneswar
- Includes: Hotel stay, Breakfast, Sightseeing
- Travel Style: Spiritual, Cultural, Family, Budget
